已有付费套餐、自动续费、欠费或其他订阅状态时，先联系客服确认是否适用，再付款。

steps.title: 下单并保存凭证
steps.text: 确认规格、当前价格与数量。游客保存邮箱、查单密码及订单号。

steps.title: 付款后领取核销码
steps.text: 返回订单确认付款和发码状态。已扣款但订单未更新时先联系客服，不重复付款。

steps.title: 验码并提交办理资料
steps.text: 通过订单提供的核销入口验码，核对账号后按页面要求提交资料并明确同意办理。

steps.title: 查询进度并确认生效
steps.text: 提交成功只是资料已收到。用原码查进度，登录账号确认套餐；异常时联系客服处理原单。

faqs.q: 需要把账号密码发给客服吗？
faqs.a: 不要把密码发给客服。若核销页要求 Session，请按页面教程获取，并仅在核销表单内提交。Session 是敏感凭证，不要发到聊天或公开页面。

faqs.q: 付款成功、收到码，就算充值完成了吗？
faqs.a: 不算。付款、发码、提交资料和套餐生效是不同阶段。请完成核销，并登录实际办理账号确认结果。

faqs.q: 多久能到账？失败可以退款吗？
faqs.a: 不承诺固定到账时间；实际以发码及核销进度为准。未发码、未使用码和已提交办理的处理方式不同，退款或换码须核对原单及使用状态，由客服按售后规则处理。

before: Prepare your own ChatGPT account with working access. This is a top-up service, not an account sale.
If you have a paid plan, auto-renewal, unpaid charges or another subscription status, confirm eligibility with support before paying.
Your order email is for order lookup. Confirm the actual account and email again when submitting redemption details.
Do not infer features, limits or subscription duration from the product name alone. Confirm any requirement before buying.

steps.title: Order and save your details
steps.text: Check the option, current price and quantity. Guests should save their email, order password and order number.

steps.title: Pay and collect your code
steps.text: Return to the order to confirm payment and code delivery. If charged without an update, contact support before paying again.

steps.title: Verify and submit details
steps.text: Use the redemption link in the order, verify your code, confirm the account and explicitly consent before submitting required details.

steps.title: Check progress and activation
steps.text: Submission only confirms receipt of details. Check progress with the original code, then sign in to confirm activation. Contact support about the existing order if needed.

faqs.q: Should I send my account password to support?
faqs.a: Do not send passwords to support. If the redemption form needs Session data, follow its instructions and submit only in that form. Session data is sensitive; never share it in chats or public pages.

faqs.q: Is payment or code delivery the same as activation?
faqs.a: No. Payment, code delivery, submission and activation are separate stages. Complete redemption and sign in to the account being topped up to confirm the result.

faqs.q: How long does it take? Can I get a refund if it fails?
faqs.a: No fixed activation time is promised. Follow order and redemption progress. Undelivered, unused and already-submitted orders require different handling. Support must review the order and code status under the applicable refund or replacement rules.

faqs.a: 不要把密碼發給客服。若核銷頁要求 Session，請按頁面教程獲取，並僅在核銷表單內提交。Session 是敏感憑證，不要發到聊天或公開頁面。

faqs.a: 不算。付款、發碼、提交資料和套餐生效是不同階段。請完成核銷，並登入實際辦理帳號確認結果。

faqs.a: 不承諾固定到賬時間；實際以發碼及核銷進度為準。未發碼、未使用碼和已提交辦理的處理方式不同，退款或換碼須核對原單及使用狀態，由客服按售後規則處理。
